content_of_post_to_comment: A benefit of having a mission that actually improves the world is that you will not feel threatened by competition. If someone copies your best ideas and devotes more resources to executing them better than you, great! The change you wanted to see in the world is now happening faster.
comment: There’s an interesting distinction between ego-free competition and mission drift: copying can accelerate the outcome, but only if the shared goal remains clear. Otherwise, scale can amplify the wrong incentives.
